articles.title: Alien signals may be hiding where we rarely listen
articles.description: Astronomers may have been listening for alien civilizations in only a small slice of the radio spectrum while overlooking a largely unexplored range of higher frequencies. No possible alien transmissions were found, but the study revealed that even a handful of telescope observations may quietly include millions of stars.
